title: Fix three bugs in a Go Counter struct
description: Fix bugs in Counter: Add decrements instead of increments, Get adds 1 (off by one), Total starts at 1 instead of 0.

task_spec.prompt:
Fix three bugs in counter.go:
1. Add: change `-= 1` to `+= 1` so the counter increments
2. Get: remove `+ 1` so it returns the raw count (missing key correctly returns 0 from Go map)
3. Total: change `total := 1` to `total := 0` so the accumulator starts at zero
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
